name: hd_key_island
prompt: A wide key art of a small cozy tropical island village seen from a three-quarter top-down view like a cozy life-sim game: soft green grass meadows, a winding light dirt path, a cream sand beach, clear turquoise sea with soft white foam lines along the shore, a few cute cottages with coral red roofs, round puffy trees, coconut palms, flower clumps, a small wooden pier

name: hd_trees
prompt: A sprite sheet of 4 separate trees in one single row with generous empty white space between them: 1) a tall coconut palm with a gently curved trunk leaning to the right, a crown of long soft fronds and a few coconuts; 2) a slightly shorter coconut palm leaning to the left; 3) a round puffy broadleaf tree with a short trunk; 4) a mango fruit tree with a round crown and a few ripe orange-yellow mangoes. Each trunk stands directly on the white background: NO ground patch, NO grass under the trunk, NO shadow

name: hd_plants
prompt: A sprite sheet of 6 separate plants in one single row with generous empty white space between them: 1) a round hibiscus bush with a few big red flowers, 2) a round bougainvillea bush with magenta blossoms, 3) a small round plain green shrub, 4) a low leafy fern clump with broad chunky fronds in rich greens, 5) a small banana plant with broad leaves and a little bunch of green bananas, 6) a tuft of tall soft grass. No ground patches, no shadows

name: hd_flowers
prompt: A sprite sheet of 6 separate small flower clumps in one single row with generous empty white space between them. Each clump is low and wide (wider than tall), three blossoms on short stems with a few leaves: 1) red tulips, 2) pink cosmos with yellow centers, 3) yellow pansies with purple faces, 4) soft pink roses, 5) blue hyacinths, 6) orange windflowers. Every petal is clearly colored, absolutely no white petals, no ground patches, no shadows

name: hd_rocks
prompt: A sprite sheet of 6 separate small beach and ground objects in one single row with generous empty white space between them: 1) a round smooth grey boulder, 2) a grey rock with a soft cap of green moss, 3) a tiny cluster of three small round pebbles, 4) a pink conch seashell, 5) a coral orange starfish, 6) a short piece of pale bleached driftwood. No ground patches, no shadows

name: hd_house
prompt: A single cute cottage seen straight from the front (front elevation, the front wall faces the viewer, the roof seen slightly from above), centered: a big rounded coral red roof with a little chimney, cream walls, a rounded wooden front door with a round window, two round windows with flower boxes, a low stone foundation step. The house stands directly on the white background: NO grass, NO ground patch, NO mailbox, NO shadow

name: hd_cast
prompt: A character lineup of the same 8 characters as the reference, standing in one single row facing the viewer with generous empty white space between them, keeping each one's hairstyle, outfit and colors: the young player in a straw hat and teal shirt, and the seven villagers. Full body, feet at the same baseline, no ground, no shadows
